items.title: The pullback along the projection from the big site to the small site, described by sections and by fpqc sheafiness
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the inverse image of a sheaf along the projection pi_S from the big Zariski or etale site of S to the small site: its sections over T -> S are the sections of f_{small}^{-1}F over T_tau, and it satisfies the sheaf condition for fpqc coverings (statement lines 4959-4973). The first part is a computation through the morphism of topoi induced by an object of the big site (proof lines 4975-4984). The second part is a genuine gluing argument: for an fpqc covering the author takes the largest open subsets on which two candidate sections agree, refines by tau-coverings of the members to make those opens cover, and concludes (proof lines 4987-5027). The non-formal content is that refinement argument. The claim is H2: one computation plus one explicit descent argument.
